statement_summary: Program based on the SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate baseline, documented in policies, standards, and the SSP
Information Security Officer designated in writing and reaffirmed yearly
Annual, new-contract, and acquisition risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no door, critical facility, or safety risk accepted above Low
Supporting standards with owners, approvals, and annual review
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Security sanctions
Security addendum and annual review for vendors and subcontractors before data or remote access
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); FAR 52.204-21(c); FAR 52.204-9(d)

statement_summary: Section 889, Kaspersky, and FASCSA screening, including subcontractor-supplied equipment; quarterly SAM.gov check
Annual independent assessment reported to the audit committee
Record retention and transfer at contract end
Contingency plan with manual-mode procedures; quarterly cluster restore tests; semiannual ROC failover drill
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (BTTRG 1.6.2 model)

statement_summary: Ticketed, second-person-approved changes; OT hardening standard; no default credentials
Patch targets; monthly edge firmware review; endpoint protection or allow-listing
Badge-controlled offices and ROC zones; panel key log and quarterly inventory
No AI tool or AI feature without approval through the AI governance process
Security due diligence before acquired companies or new contracts connect
Named accounts only, including subcontractor technicians; vault for device credentials
Role-based least privilege; integrators never tenant administrators
MFA for all; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
Remote access to customer OT only through the broker with approval and recording; tools, relays, and modems prohibited
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); CT-C2 and CT-M addenda

statement_summary: Same-day access removal across tenants and clusters; PIV card return on the last day
Remove previous customer access within 5 business days of a transfer
Quarterly reviews of OT administrator and all other access
Account lockout and screen lock
14-character passwords; change default passwords before connecting any device
Only GSA-provided access paths on GSA systems
Log and review sign-ins, admin actions, sessions, program downloads, and door schedule changes
Remote unlock of the voting equipment cage disabled; two-person access
Customer tenants and clusters federated to the identity provider or reconciled daily
Incident response plan and runbooks for OT intrusion and ransomware
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Put buildings in a safe state first
Log and track every incident
Severity 1 incidents to the crisis management team within 1 hour
Customer notice within 6 hours (County A ransomware), 24 hours, 48 hours, or immediately (GSA)
regulatory_driver: CT-C1 addendum; CT-S exhibit; CT-C2 and CT-M addenda; C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (BTTRG 1.6.1)

statement_summary: Legal notices per the notification matrix; General Counsel decision log
Ransom decision rules; never pay on a customer's behalf
Annual tabletop with a customer; each runbook every 2 years
Incident response training within 30 days of assignment and annually
Lessons learned within 30 days into the risk register and POA&M
Evidence with chain of custody; forensics at counsel's direction
Four classification levels
CUI only in the CUI library; marked; secure links; CUI email attachments blocked
Security system plans handled as Restricted
Public records requests routed through General Counsel to the customer custodian
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; isolate protocols that cannot encrypt
Data location register including subcontractor copies
Wipe or destroy media; shred paper; wipe copiers at lease return; OT drives wiped or receipted
Isolated, encrypted, write-once backups; quarterly restore tests; central program repository
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools; face template deletion within 30 days
Customer data transferred or destroyed at contract end
Acknowledgment at hire and yearly
No posting of customer equipment or security details
Annual awareness training; monthly phishing exercises
Role-based OT, administrator, and CUI training before access and annually
No unapproved software, remote tools, USB storage, or panel modems
Call-back verification; only named managers approve broker sessions
Approved AI tools only; no AI or biometric features without a P10 assessment
